h1: Verbier ski resort, stays & events guide
heroText: Verbier has 106 kilometres of runs and 33 lifts of its own, on a 4 Vallées network that runs to 410 kilometres - the largest ski area entirely within Switzerland. Mont-Fort tops the network at 3,330 metres, and the speed-skiing run drops 383 metres over 1,400.
stayOverview: The resort station at 1,515 metres is where the lifts and the bars are; Verbier Village below it is the old hamlet; Le Châble on the valley floor has the railway and a gondola up.
hotelIntro: Book against high season. Le Châble is much cheaper but adds a gondola ride at both ends of the day.
rentalCars: Le Châble has a railway station with a gondola up to Verbier, so the resort is reachable without a car.
